title: Host Damage Protection (HostCover) Terms: Level Eligibility, Activation, Level Changes, Cancellation and Lapse
content:
These clauses of **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** govern which level a listing may hold, when a plan starts covering stays, how a level change applies, and what cancellation and lapse do.

## Clauses

1. **Eligibility.** A level may be held only on a listing whose space type is among the level's eligible space types, and only while the host account is active.
2. **Effective date and plan year.** A plan is enrolled in pending activation and becomes effective the level's waiting period in calendar days after enrollment, when it becomes active. Its plan year runs from the effective date and renews on each anniversary.
3. **Level changes.** A level change takes effect for stays checking in after the change date; stays already checked in stay under the level they checked in under.
4. **Change cooldown.** A plan's level can be changed only when at least the level-change cooldown in calendar days has passed since its last level change; the days are counted from the date of the last level change (or from the enrollment date when the level was never changed), and a change on the last day of the period is allowed. The cooldown is 90 calendar days on every level.
5. **Cancellation.** The host may cancel a plan before it starts or while it is active. Cancelling a plan never refunds premiums already charged where the level does not refund premium on cancellation, and a cancelled paid plan falls back to HostCover Essential only through a new enrollment.
6. **Lapse.** A plan lapses when its listing is removed or its host account is deactivated.
7. **Run-off.** A plan that is cancelled or lapsed still covers stays that checked in while it was active.

## The cooldown clause, case by case

The anchor is the plan's last level change date, or its enrollment date when the level has never been changed. The earliest permitted change date is the anchor plus 90 calendar days, and a change on that date stands.

| Hypothetical plan | Anchor | Proposed change date | Calendar days since anchor | Change permitted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Level last changed on 2026-01-10 | 2026-01-10 | 2026-04-10 | 90 | Yes, the last day of the period |
| Level last changed on 2026-01-10 | 2026-01-10 | 2026-04-09 | 89 | No |
| Never changed, enrolled 2026-01-10 | 2026-01-10 (enrollment) | 2026-04-10 | 90 | Yes |

## Which level governs a stay after a change (hypothetical)

A host moves a plan to a new level on 15 June. A stay that checked in on 12 June stays under the old level. A stay checking in on 16 June is under the new level.

## Status of the plan in the records

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| pending activation | enrolled, waiting period not yet over |
| active | effective date reached; covering stays |
| cancelled | cancelled by the host |
| lapsed | ended because the listing was removed or the host account deactivated |
